accessLimitations.limitation: Direct open returned 403. Their indexed official page text was reviewed instead; no protection bypass attempted.
Address tools located and service-layer purpose verified; no household address was entered and parcel-level boundaries were not exhaustively tested.
Root fetch failed; the Public Works URL opened and redirected to the current ssfca.gov domain used in the directory.
Old hostname redirected to westlightenergy.org. New name separately corroborated by official July 1, 2026 release and Redwood City page.
Contact page is indexed with an older crawl. Phone also appears on current operator home/customer pages; no old seasonal flush notice or office-hour promise is reproduced.

editorialResolutions: Use WestLight Energy (formerly Peninsula Clean Energy), not only the former PCE name, as of the requested date.
Use current Cal Water district phone numbers. Some town directories still show older Bear Gulch and Los Altos Suburban numbers.
Do not list Los Trancos County Water District as an independent current household water signup provider; current Cal Water Bear Gulch coverage explicitly includes Los Trancos.

Daly City legacy water FAQ and newer Republic page differ on garbage account wording. Publish separate city water and Republic residential waste contacts, without claiming unified city garbage billing.

East Palo Alto's current live utility directory still lists Veolia. Older planning/lease materials mention an April 2026 contract endpoint, but a replacement operator was not established by reviewed evidence. Publish the city system and current city contact, attribute Veolia to that directory, and link the live municipal page.
NCCWD delivery to Crystal Springs Terrace is water purchased by the City of San Bruno; do not create a misleading second household retail provider for San Bruno.
Woodside boundary detail relies on town planning material and county water-extension records in addition to current Cal Water coverage. Exact parcels require confirmation.
Half Moon Bay's county directory and city bulky-pickup page show different purpose-specific Republic numbers; omit a generic phone and retain the official municipality contact URL.
Keep Palo Alto CPAU and Santa Clara Silicon Valley Power separate from PG&E electric signup. CCA agencies are generation suppliers, not line-connection providers.
San José waste companies differ by region, dwelling type and material stream. Lead with the city account/311 route and preserve the contractor roles.

Apartment/condominium accounts, shared meters, master-meter billing, private wells, new construction connections, sewer/septic service and unincorporated mailing addresses require separate property/address confirmation.
omissions: No incorporated city omitted from the two-county scope.
No unverified phone was inferred for a provider.
No broadband/telecommunications research included; handled by parent task.
No rates, deposits, identity-document requirements, enrollment guarantees or legal obligations asserted in this contact dataset.
